canonical_scenes.title: Anna at the Window (First Meeting)
canonical_scenes.setting: Romano house garden, adjacent to Miyazaki residence
canonical_scenes.scene_objective: establish Kairi-Anna dyad, introduce hāfu difference, signal narrative pivot
canonical_scenes.perceptual_dominance: sight, including Kairi's attention to Anna's hāfu appearance and facial features; touch through hand-holding initiation
canonical_scenes.lasting_consequence: Anna becomes a life-defining emotional anchor; subsequent scenes reference or develop this relationship

canonical_scenes.title: Sugar Cube Pact at Miyazaki Kissaten
canonical_scenes.setting: Kissaten Miyazaki interior, father's domain, afternoon light
canonical_scenes.scene_objective: ritualize friendship, embed loyalty in taste-memory, establish kissaten as sanctuary
key_dialogue: Kairi: 'Con lo zucchero. Niente è più dolce di questa amicizia'
canonical_scenes.performative_sequence: both bite sugar cube simultaneously, eyes locked
canonical_scenes.visual_proof: Atsuo's smile as paternal recognition of the friendship

canonical_scenes.title: Igloo Construction — Collective Labor
canonical_scenes.setting: field margins at Hirosaki edge, snow-covered
canonical_scenes.scene_objective: anchor friendship in physical collaboration, show resilience through play
sensory_register: touch: cold snow compacting in hands, ice texture
sight: white dome emerging from white field
smell: cold pre-snow air and wind-carried forest scents
canonical_scenes.recurrence_significance: repeated across three winters; the activity returns while participants and emotional context change

canonical_scenes.title: Father & Daughter Pilgrimage to Monte Iwaki
canonical_scenes.setting: foothills of Monte Iwaki, elevation gain, silence-heavy
canonical_scenes.scene_objective: process emerging paternal strain, anchor Kairi in mountain-wisdom, establish non-verbal bonding
canonical_scenes.key_moment: Atsuo points toward Hirosaki below and says: 'Bisogna prendere le cose alla giusta distanza'

canonical_scenes.title: Reira's Drawer — The 'Cerbiatta' Photograph
canonical_scenes.setting: Miyazaki family bedroom, afternoon, Kairi searching for sewing supplies
canonical_scenes.scene_objective: rupture childhood trust, reveal maternal secret, trigger family dissolution cascade
canonical_scenes.perceptual_dominance: sight (photograph detail), smell (perfume associated with envelope), emotion (shock-rage)
canonical_scenes.photograph_detail: Reira in forest, nude or semi-nude, face radiant rather than presented through maternal domestic identity, signed 'Cerbiatta' in lover's handwriting
canonical_scenes.psychological_aftermath: Kairi's realization: 'Non sono come mia madre'
canonical_scenes.consequence_cascade: leads to confrontation, separation, Atsuo's departure, and Reira's disappearance

canonical_scenes.title: Atsuo Learns the Truth — Family Rupture
canonical_scenes.scene_objective: collapse nuclear family, establish Kairi-Atsuo household, set Reira as absent force
confrontation_sequence: Atsuo reacts with shock, recognition, and anger
Atsuo: 'So this is who you've become'
Reira returns unexpectedly, sees photograph, and understands
Reira reacts with anger and grabs Kairi's arm
Physical separation; Atsuo takes Kairi's hand and they leave
canonical_scenes.emotional_aftermath: relief + abandonment confusion; Reira disappears overnight

canonical_scenes.title: Vacation at Grandparents' House — Ryuji Encounter
canonical_scenes.setting: Ajigasawa, coastal village, ocean-side grandparent home
canonical_scenes.scene_objective: adolescent romantic awakening, oceanic symbolism, freedom in displacement
sensory_register: taste: salt spray, fresh seaweed soup
sight: Monte Iwaki haze-distant, ocean vastness
touch: cold ocean water, Ryuji's hand-contact in water
smell: Japan Sea salt, summer humidity
canonical_scenes.key_moment: Kairi and Ryuji swim together; their hands briefly touch underwater without words
canonical_scenes.consequence: letter-writing correspondence begins; relationship remains primarily epistolary

canonical_scenes.title: Yuki Teaching Origami — Maternal Transmission
canonical_scenes.scene_objective: establish Yuki as an alternative maternal figure, anchor Kairi in creative discipline
ritual_elements: Kairi struggles with paper crease angles
Yuki does not criticize and offers comfort: 'You can sit like me'
Kairi's first successful objects: cat and dog, imperfect but celebrated
canonical_scenes.emotional_valence: belonging through creative practice, non-verbal transmission
canonical_scenes.significance: Yuki's hands communicate what words cannot

canonical_scenes.title: New Year's Eve at Temple — Y2K Crossing
canonical_scenes.scene_objective: mark century threshold, reinforce friendship ritual, embed Kairi in a communal spiritual practice
ritual_components: 108 bell chimes associated with the 108 bonnō
canonical_scenes.significance: Y2K crossing functions as a temporal threshold between childhood and adolescence

scene_distribution.note: Recurring scenes may belong to multiple years; distribution counts scene-year occurrences rather than unique scenes.

scene_function_in_protocol: Each canonical scene functions as a graph node; reader interrogation of a scene can trigger related perceptual-field, ritual, transition, object, and weather data
